name: Tape undo / redo
author: hundekraft
description: Every recording can be undone, up to seven steps back: takes, punch-ins, overdubs, loop takes, lift, drop, slide (Shift + blue), split, join and the tape edits below. It works with the tape stopped or playing. Sliding a clip takes two undo steps: the first undoes the drop, the second restores the lift.
credits: Rebuilt by hundekraft from how Maiko Pruett's #249 and #250 work; none of Maiko's code is used
